description:
El Chaparral needs no introduction for those living on the Costa del Sol. Located halfway between La Cala de Mijas and Fuengirola, this charming small-scale complex is strongly associated with one of the most popular sports in the area: golf.

These contemporary Mijas Costa golf homes are ideally located right next to the El Chaparral Golf Course, a short walk from the beach of the same name and very close to the vibrant entertainment area of La Cala De Mijas and the historic center of Fuengirola. There is a bus stop close by that will take you to both of these locations in minutes ideal for those days when you feel like leaving the car at home.

Not only is El Chaparral a truly beautiful location offering peace and tranquility in abundance, it is also well connected to a range of bars, restaurants and entertainment facilities making it the perfect place to call home or indeed a lucrative rental investment.

Comprised of 80, three and four bedroom layouts these Mijas Costa golf homes strive to provide the perfect combination of design and comfort. The living areas and home décor are designed to make the most of the abundance of natural light which this part of the coast is so well known for. Oversized windows, large porcelain stoneware floor tiles and the orientation of the homes make the most of natural light at any time of the day. Not to mention the wonderful terraces where you can watch the wonderful sunsets.

There are a selection of personalization options for the owners of these fabulous golf properties, such as kitchen unit finishes, flooring and bathroom cladding, this will of course depend on when you buy the property as once construction is advanced these personalisation options are no longer available.

Just 20 minutes from the lively and stylish city of Marbella in one direction, and Málaga airport in the other, these beautiful Mijas Costa Golf homes offer everything you need for an authentic Mediterranean lifestyle.
